drivingQuestion: Who taught that meat entering an idol house is permitted?
outcomeNote: the mishna is not like R' Elazar

segments.he: בָּשָׂר הַנִּכְנָס לַעֲבוֹדָה זָרָה מוּתָּר. מַאן תַּנָּא? אָמַר רַבִּי חִיָּיא בַּר אַבָּא אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן: דְּלָא כְּרַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר, דְּאִי כְּרַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר, הָאָמַר: סְתָם מַחְשֶׁבֶת גּוֹי לַעֲבוֹדָה זָרָה.
segments.en: § The mishna further teaches: «Meat that enters the» house of «idol worship,» before it is sacrificed, is «permitted.» The Gemara asks: «Who» is the tanna who «taught» this? «Rabbi Ḥiyya bar Abba said» that «Rabbi Yoḥanan said:» It is «not in accordance with» the opinion of «Rabbi Elazar, as if» one were to posit that it is «in accordance with» the opinion of «Rabbi Elazar,» this would be difficult: «Doesn’t he say:» When slaughtering an animal, «a gentile’s unspecified intention» is to use it «for idol worship?» Accordingly, Rabbi Elazar would disagree with the ruling of the mishna that meat entering a house of idol worship is permitted.
